name: Michael Darling
original_name: マイケル・ダーリング
source:
Wendy’s younger brother, but not related by blood.

Officially has the temperament of the baby of the family. He’s superficial, the opposite of his brother. He has a non-serious side, but is flexible and smooth, so it’s easy for superiors to dote on him.

He loves sweets. He’s particularly fond of cakes, and not only just eating, he’s also eager in making them.
